interface.name: xw_workspace_info_v1
interface.description:
This companion protocol annotates zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 objects with the workspace the compositor places them on. Panels and pagers need it to draw a workspace-aware view of running windows; the wlr foreign toplevel protocol itself carries no workspace field, and ext-workspace does not assign toplevels.
The manager is read-only: workspaces are switched and windows are moved with the established protocols (ext-workspace activate, window manager rules). Binding an annotation costs one object per tracked toplevel; unbinding the manager releases them all.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager and every annotation object created from it. The server side stops sending workspace events.

request.name: get_toplevel_workspace
request.description: Creates an annotation object for the given foreign toplevel handle and immediately sends its current workspace, followed by a done event. Later assignments emit workspace and done pairs.

interface.name: xw_workspace_toplevel_v1
interface.description: Emits the workspace index of the annotated toplevel whenever the compositor moves it. index is 0-based; -1 marks a sticky window (present on every workspace).

request.name: destroy
request.description: After destroy, no further workspace events are sent for it.

event.name: done

description.summary: all events for the last change were sent

event.description: Sent after the initial annotation and after each later workspace event, so clients can coalesce relayouts.
